items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: What happened to Davy Jones anyway? Oh he's out west someplace. He's out in California like the time I was there. He seems to have disappeared that day. I guess I could find him if I ever get out that way.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Henry Russell's playing drums. Oh yeah.

What happened to Davy Jones anyway? Oh he's out west someplace. He's out in California like the time I was there. He seems to have disappeared that day. I guess I could find him if I ever get out that way.
He probably sees Paul Barnes. Yes.
